rows.reply_en:
Hello,

To swap a shift, open the shift in the app and tap "Offer swap". Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. If manager approval is turned on, the manager approves it under Rota → Requests.

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
rows.verified_en: Dear, To swap a shift, you open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden". Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. If manager approval is enabled, the manager approves this under Rooster → Verzoeken. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

rows.reply_en:
Dear,

The Plus plan costs €6 per active employee per month (excluding VAT). For 25 active employees, that would be €150 per month (excl. VAT).

You can upgrade your subscription at any time under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). The new price applies from the next invoice.

Kind regards,
Team Roosterly
